title: FORTH: Grounding Tactile VLA Execution via Forward-Only Proxy-Control Pairing
description:
arXiv:2611.26744v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are widely credited with force control, operating on the unverified assumption that proxy loss minimization implies physical force grounding. In this work, we demonstrate that this assumption breaks down at three core deployment levels: frozen visual backbones discard contact geometry, downstream losses mask token-level gradient alignment, and discrete indicators trigger optimization collapse.
